checks.meaning: Selected exact module-ID/query, final Vite writeBundle bytes, shared Rollup chunk, namespace/path, and ownership corruption checks. Filtered-out tests were not independently rerun.
Positive reproduction of the remaining source-to-output provenance limitation, not a successful rejection.

confirmedFindings.observation: Root's actual app build found index-chunk bytes differing from the earlier user generateBundle capture. Vite performs later preload/import-analysis changes. The production capture now runs writeBundle order=post,sequential=true, and the builder independently compares captured hashes with final disk files. The selected real Vite fixture confirms early bytes differ while finalized capture matches disk.

reproduction: Create a valid separate assets/book-lazy.js referenced by a real dynamic import; remove the BookArchiveSection direct Vite source key and record exact shared-chunk ownership.
Confirm auditor has no findings with that real chunk in bootstrap.
Reassign only the BookArchiveSection sidecar record to existing assets/app.js; remove book-lazy.js from bootstrap while retaining its file, inventory, Vite entry and executable dynamic import.
Recompute the sidecar hash and internally consistent build/configuration/worker/inventory hashes. Auditor still reports no findings.
confirmedFindings.implication: The current static auditor validates internal consistency and captured source/output hashes, but an independently rewritten sidecar cannot establish faithful source-to-binary compilation. A cold offline book check can detect this omission in the tested actual artifact, not all possible executable changes.
confirmedFindings.requiredExactRcEvidence: An explicitly trusted receipt outside the artifact, bound to sourceInputs, build configuration, exact Rollup module IDs and finalized output hashes; or an independent repeat compilation with exact map/output comparison. Artifact-supplied self-asserted receipt paths/hashes are insufficient.

reviewedProperties: Exact normalized module/facade IDs are used; primary/retry query IDs remain distinct.
Shared chunks resolve by exact output file, never basename or substring.
Ownership source and aggregate input hashes are compared with current source records; output hashes are checked against disk/inventory.
The ownership sidecar belongs to verified bootstrap and therefore participates in the build identity.
Static import closure and explicitly selected dynamic entry outputs remain required.
limitations: No full application build or app/server start by this reviewer.
Root's fresh application build and cold offline catalog/browser checks were still pending when requested; this report does not claim their outcome.
No native artifacts, human copy approval, production deployment or release action is covered.
